cognitive training + phosphotidylserine is the most effective treatment for AD, followed by cognitive training + pyrotinol and cognitive training alone.
activation PET is a sensitive and specific tool to detect the efficacy of a cognitive training intervention.
cognitive training + phospholipid supplementation is superior to social support or cognitive training only.

the development of a new instrument, activation PET, to determine therapeutic efficacy in Alzheimer's disease.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the PET activation technique is a useful tool to determine the therapeutic efficacy of a given intervention in Alzheimer's disease.
PET is a useful tool for the investigation of the therapeutic efficacy of drugs in patients with Alzheimer's disease.
the PET technique can be used as a tool in clinical trials to determine whether a treatment is effective or not.
